blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the P537.91 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the P109.18 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026. According to the PCSO results, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 26-33-18-46-15-14, with a jackpot prize of P537.91
